classifications.internal: Repository engineering/product documentation for authenticated team use. Not public by default.
classifications.public_candidate: May be published only after product-owner, editorial, privacy and security review.
classifications.restricted: Secrets, customer data, private network topology, privileged access and sensitive security material. Never public or in public search indexes.
classifications.unknown: Owner, audience, rights or sensitivity not yet verified. Keep internal until classified.

policy.access_rule: Enforce source ACL before rendering or exposing titles, snippets, metadata, search facets, exports or attachments.
policy.source_of_truth: Version-controlled repository file and its commit, not a copied Docs database record.

authorities.authority: Canonical task identity, dependency, status, owner, approval and evidence ledger

authorities.write_policy: Governed source changes; implementation truth must be separately evidenced
Update with the corresponding ADR decision
Refresh evidence commit and audit date when re-audited

authorities.authority: Governance, change and historical audit records
authorities.write_policy: Append or supersede; preserve historical records

authorities.authority: DX environment observations and agent capability inventory
authorities.write_policy: Only observed facts; unknown host/provider data remains unknown

authorities.authority: Executable task protocols, schema specifications and validator code

authorities.write_policy: Review for disclosure before publishing externally
Generated platform evidence; cannot be authored by Docs UI
No independent status or ADR authority

known_conflicts.issue: Historical task statuses for APP-001/PKG-001 and old audited commit are stale relative to the current task ledger.
known_conflicts.resolution: Treat as historical; refresh in a separate governance audit.

known_conflicts.issue: Current-main commit and PR list stop before subsequent merged work.
known_conflicts.resolution: Append a new audit snapshot; do not rewrite historical change records.

known_conflicts.issue: Evidence commit identifiers are older than the currently inspected main commit.
known_conflicts.resolution: Re-run the file-tree and package baseline audit before presenting as current.

known_conflicts.issue: Commit and CI references identify the earlier DX baseline.
known_conflicts.resolution: Keep capability distinctions but refresh references after the next DX audit.

non_goals: No Docs app scaffold or publishing backend is created by this inventory.
No document is made public by this classification.
No external wiki, private host, customer data source, secrets store or production system is accessed.
